summary.name: Synfig Studio
summary.one_liner: Synfig Studio is free, open-source 2D animation software for making film-quality vector and bitmap animation without drawing every frame by hand.
summary.what_it_does: Synfig Studio computes inbetween frames automatically once you set key positions, so vector shapes can be tweened into other shapes. It offers over 50 layer types, including geometric shapes, gradients, filters, distortions, transformations and fractals. A bone system supports cutout animation with bitmap images or control of vector artwork, and a Skeleton Distortion layer applies complex deformations to bitmaps. Parameters of layers can be linked directly or through mathematical expressions to build character puppets and dynamic structures.
notable: Free and open-source under GNU GPL v3, sources on GitHub
Vector tweening with automatic inbetween frames
Full bone system and Skeleton Distortion layer for cutout animation
Two binary build channels: stable and experimental
caveats: Requires at least 2GB RAM and a dual-core 2 GHz CPU
Windows requires Windows 7 or above; OS X requires 10.8 or above; Linux requires a distro released in 2012 or later
